fact: Rwanda adopted the Umucyo e-procurement system in 2017; per RPPA statistics 19,850 tenders were published, about 85,000 procurements processed and 16,976 contracts signed through the portal, with 210 procuring entities using it (reported at the 13th East African Procurement Forum, 15 April 2021).
title: Les pays de la communauté de l'Afrique de l'est obligés de faire avec la commande publique électronique
publisher: RACOP, Réseau Africain de Commande Publique
